title: Post Click Prediction
prompt:
This machine-learning engineering exercise is a hands-on tabular prediction task. You receive a tidy JSON dataset in which each record is a post shown to a user, and you must estimate whether that user will select the post.

Read the JSON input, turn records into a pandas DataFrame, review available columns, transform input variables, fit a baseline along with sensible alternatives, measure model performance, and justify the decisions and compromises involved.

The dataset fields are:

- hours_spent_reading_a (float)
- hours_spent_reading_b (float)
- hours_spent_reading_c (float)
- current_post_category (A, B, or C)
- click (binary label)

The first three fields record prior reading time for posts from each category; current_post_category identifies the category of the currently displayed post; click records whether it was selected. Create a model that predicts click.

Assume the raw data is in data.json. Reported datasets are complete, without substantial class skew, and contain uncomplicated numerical and categorical fields.
